    tidygenclust: Clustering for Population Genetics in R

    tidygenclust-package.Rd

    A tidy interface for population genetic clustering. This package provides a unified workflow to estimate, compare, summarize, and visualize genetic clustering analyses, supporting both single runs and collections of replicate analyses. It is designed to work natively with diploid and pseudohaploid data, and integrates seamlessly with the tidypopgen ecosystem. The package includes native R/C++ implementations of the ancestry estimation method of ADMIXTURE (Alexander et al. 2009), using a modified version of the algorithm of OpenADMIXTURE (Ko et al. 2023), adapted to operate directly on the backing files of tidypopgen objects while correctly handling pseudohaploid data, and extended with the cross-validation of ADMIXTURE, and of the cluster-alignment method of clumppling (Liu, Kopelman & Rosenberg 2024), ported with modifications from its python implementation, for the comparison of multiple clustering runs. Optionally, tidygenclust can also run external clustering software, including fastmixture and ADMIXTURE, which are installed automatically in a dedicated conda environment (the conda environment only works in Linux and macOS).
